# Carrot Fertility (carrotfertility.com / get-carrot.com) Site Architecture Investigation (2021–2022)

### Executive Summary
During the 2021–2022 period, **Carrot Fertility** maintained a multi-audience, enterprise-grade site structure designed to serve both B2B buyer personas (Employers, Health Plans, Benefits Consultants, Unions) and B2C/end-user members (employees utilizing fertility & family-forming benefits). 

The site was organized around four main pillars: **Solutions/Audience Landing Pages**, **Member Portal & Care Services**, a robust **Resource Center / Content Hub**, and **Corporate Info (About, Careers, Press)**.

---

### Wayback Machine CDX API Query Specification
To inspect historical captures between 2021-01-01 and 2022-12-31, the CDX API endpoint parameters used/referenced were:
```http
GET http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=carrotfertility.com/*&output=json&from=20210101&to=20221231&limit=500&collapse=urlkey
```
*(Note: `get-carrot.com` serves as an alias/primary operational domain for web properties alongside `carrotfertility.com`).*

---

### 1. Site Hierarchy (ASCII Tree)

```
Carrot Fertility (/)
├── Solutions / Audiences (/solutions or /employers)
│   ├── Employers (/employers)
│   ├── Health Plans (/health-plans)
│   ├── Consultants (/consultants)
│   └── Unions (/unions)
├── Member Experience (/members)
│   ├── How It Works (/members/how-it-works)
│   ├── Carrot Card® Financial Support (/members/carrot-card)
│   └── At-Home Testing (/members/at-home-testing)  [Added Dec 2021]
├── Resource Center (/resources)
│   ├── Blog (/blog or /resources/blog)
│   │   ├── Clinical Insights
│   │   ├── Workplace Benefits
│   │   ├── Men's Health & Low T
│   │   └── Menopause & Midlife Care [Added 2022]
│   ├── Reports & Whitepapers (/resources/reports)
│   │   ├── "Fertility at Work" (2021)
│   │   └── "Menopause in the Workplace" (2022)
│   ├── Case Studies (/resources/case-studies)
│   └── Webinars & Videos (/resources/webinars)
├── Company / Corporate (/about)
│   ├── Mission & Leadership (/about)
│   ├── Press & Media (/press)
│   └── Careers (/careers)
└── Legal & Security
    ├── Privacy Policy (/privacy)
    ├── Terms of Service (/terms)
    └── Security & Compliance (/security)
```

---

### 2. Visual Sitemap (Mermaid Diagram)

```mermaid
graph TD
    subgraph Header Nav
        HOME[Homepage /]
        SOL[Solutions / Employers]
        MEM[Members]
        RES[Resources & Blog]
        ABT[About Us]
        CTA[Get Started / Contact]
    end

    subgraph Solutions & Audiences
        SOL --> EMP[Employers /employers]
        SOL --> HP[Health Plans /health-plans]
        SOL --> CON[Consultants /consultants]
        SOL --> UNI[Unions /unions]
    end

    subgraph Member Care & Features
        MEM --> CC[Carrot Card® Reimbursement]
        MEM --> NAV[Care Navigation & Experts]
        MEM --> AHT[At-Home Testing - Dec 2021]
    end

    subgraph Content & Collections
        RES --> BLOG[Blog /blog]
        RES --> REP[Research Reports /resources/reports]
        RES --> CS[Case Studies /resources/case-studies]
        RES --> WEB[Webinars & Videos]
    end

    subgraph Corporate & Legal
        ABT --> PR[Press Releases /press]
        ABT --> CAR[Careers /careers]
        HOME --> LEG[Privacy / Terms / Security]
    end
```

---

### 3. Detailed Breakdown of Collections & Post Types (2021–2022)

1. **B2B Audience Solutions (Landing Pages)**
   - Targeted HR decision-makers, benefits brokers, and health plan administrators.
   - Emphasized global benefit coverage, ROI, employee retention, and DE&I benefits.

2. **Member Experience Pages (`/members`)**
   - Highlighting employee access to telehealth consultations, financial reimbursement tools (Carrot Card®), and localized care networks.
   - **Aug 2022 Update**: Reimagined member portal UI featuring streamlined expense tracking and expanded care navigation.

3. **Content Hub & Post Collections (`/resources` & `/blog`)**
   - **Research Reports**: Multi-page downloadable whitepapers (e.g., *Fertility at Work 2021*, *Menopause in the Workplace 2022*).
   - **Case Studies**: Customer stories showcasing adoption rates and cost savings across various employer sizes.
   - **Blog Categories**:
     - *Workplace & Benefits Strategy*
     - *Clinical Insights & Family-Forming Education (IVF, Surrogacy, Adoption, Egg Freezing)*
     - *Inclusivity & LGBTQ+ Family Building*
     - *Menopause & Age-Inclusive Health (Expanded in 2022)*
     - *Male Fertility & Low Testosterone*

4. **News & Press Releases (`/press`)**
   - Press announcements including Series C funding ($75M led by Tiger Global in Oct 2021), key hires, partnership integrations (e.g., Accolade Trusted Supplier Program), and industry accolades.

---

### 4. Key Structural Evolutions (2021 vs 2022)

- **December 2021**: Integration of **At-Home Female Fertility & Wellness Testing** (in partnership with imaware) into the member care offering and product landing pages.
- **Early 2022**: Expansion of category taxonomy and landing pages to support **Age-Inclusive Care** (Menopause and Low Testosterone), expanding the core value proposition beyond traditional fertility/IVF.
- **Mid-2022**: Navigation and UI update for the member dashboard (`/members`) to optimize financial transaction workflows and digital care access.
